thread:
maria: quick question — bringing up hf://acme/sqz-1 in staging, runtime falls back to slow tokenizer. error says `no tokenizer.json`. anyone seen this pattern?

aj: can you paste the exact error / log snippet?

maria: sure — from the pod logs:

```
2026-03-18T14:02:11Z ERROR runtime: Failed to load fast tokenizer: tokenizer.json not found
2026-03-18T14:02:11Z WARN runtime: Falling back to slow python tokenizer (tokenizer_config.json present)
2026-03-18T14:02:11Z INFO eval: Running smoke evals with slow tokenizer
```

maria: model still loads but stochastic evals show weird tokenization on prompt prefixes (special tokens inserted twice).

leo: this is classic fast vs slow artifact mismatch. Many HF repos ship *only* tokenizer_config.json + vocab files; the rust-based fast Tokenizers expect tokenizer.json (the serialized tokenizer). Without it transformers will construct a slow tokenizer from files which can change special token ids/normalization.

aj: oh — that explains the eval regression we saw yesterday (spike in ppl + rouge drop). did the model repo include special_tokens_map.json?

maria: there is a specials json: special_tokens_map.json exists and tokenizer_config.json lists `bos_token`/`eos_token`. no tokenizer.json.

leo: two practical fixes: 1) regenerate tokenizer.json from the slow files and commit it, or 2) update our HF-to-Redwood onboarding job to synthesize tokenizer.json at import time (we did something similar for the tiny-bert bringup).

aj: regen command I used before (devbox):
```
python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; from transformers import AutoTokenizer
# load slow then save fast
slow = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('path_or_repo', use_fast=False)
slow.save_pretrained('out_dir')
# tokenizers library will serialize a tokenizer.json if the fast tokenizer exists
```

leo: note: sometimes `AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(..., use_fast=True)` fails if there's no tokenizers implementation; regenerating with `use_fast=False` then calling `Tokenizer.from_file`/`save` can help. Also check `added_tokens` vs `special_tokens_map` — if duplication exists you get token id shift.

maria: we instrumented a quick eval: with slow tokenizer rouge-L 0.41, with a hand-generated tokenizer.json it jumps to 0.45. so the missing file was material.

ci-bot: ci: new test failure: node 3 tox-integration detected tokenization mismatch in integration-tests/qa-suites (diff hash: 0x7f33).

aj: plan: I'll add a step to the onboarding script to assert presence of tokenizer.json *or* run a conversion routine and write one. I'll also add a quick checksum diff against special_tokens_map.json to detect duplicates. will open PR.

leo: also add a short eval check: compare tokenized ids length on 50 canonical prompts between fast and slow path — if mean length diff > 0.5 fail bringup. saved us before on quantize regressions.

maria: thanks. tagging infra: @aj please also flag this on the import report so eng-runtime can avoid silently falling back in prod.

aj: yep. creating ticket RED-PLT-4512, PR coming in ~30m.

maria: perfect. leaving notes here: - missing tokenizer.json -> fallback to slow tokenizer - special_tokens duplication can shift IDs and break quantized runs - short eval check catches regressions early
